exposure: FGR with cardiac remodeling vs. FGR without cardiac remodeling
outcome: Neonatal admission to special care unit
cohort: 212 singleton pregnancies complicated by late-onset FGR
finding: Fetal cardiac remodeling is associated with adverse perinatal outcomes in late FGR and is positively associated with umbilical vein blood flow but not with fetal arterial Dopplers.
birth_weight: Lower in fetuses with cardiac remodeling (2390 g vs. 2490 g)
